# Changelog
=========

### 2.29.4

*   Release Jul 6, 2022
    *   \[bugfix\] Fix ReDoS in preprocessRFC2822 regex [#6015](https://github.com/moment/moment/pull/6015)

### 2.28.0 [See full changelog](https://gist.github.com/marwahaha/028fd6c2b2470b2804857cfd63c0e94f)

*   Release Sept 13, 2020

    *   \[bugfix\] Fix bug where .format() modifies original instance
    *   \[feature\] Add support for eras in en and jp
    *   \[feature\] Accept custom relative thresholds in duration.humanize
    *   18 bugfixes
    *   36 locale fixes
    *   5 new locales (oc-lnc, zh-mo, en-in, gom-deva, fil)
